purpose: same-state request-variant diagnostic, added after the source-partition audit found no exact-context request pairs
selection: 32 unique strict-test scenarios, round-robin across canonical labels, selection seed 20261001
targets: unchanged synthetic compliance-contract labels from canonical strict-test records; no prediction-derived references
instructions: Assess the proposed dispatch action using the supplied operating context and return its compliance classification.
For this operating state and proposed action, identify whether the applicable requirements are satisfied, including any monitoring condition.
held_constant: complete input object, proposed action, operating state, operator goal, and reference label
models: same pinned base model and the three saved adapters; no additional training or checkpoint selection
metrics: label agreement and both predictions correct on 32 pairs
scope: controlled request rendering for the compliance contract; no claim of unrestricted dispatcher-language equivalence
